title: Oracle Data Consumer — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Oracle Data Consumer solution should meet the objective: Consume a mock feed and reject invalid or stale values. Test timestamp boundaries and document the oracle trust model. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
